schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 047 - Terminal Plugin Tool Boundary

questions.label: Should the Terminal plugin expose only the user terminal panel or also runtime terminal app tools?
questions.help: Recommended: Terminal plugin owns the user terminal panel; runtime terminal app tools are C4OS tool-gateway tools that may be displayed by Terminal/Chat Debug but are not the same as the user terminal.
options: User terminal panel only; runtime terminal tools stay C4OS tool-gateway owned
Terminal plugin owns both user terminal and runtime terminal app tools
Runtime terminal tools require Terminal plugin enabled
No terminal app tools; only user terminal
Other

questions.label: Where should runtime terminal tool activity be visible?
questions.help: Recommended: normal thread context plus Chat Debug; Terminal panel remains the user's interactive PTY.
options: Thread context plus Chat Debug; Terminal panel stays user PTY
Terminal panel only
Chat Debug only
Thread context only
Other

questions.label: Which terminal settings belong in config.toml versus Terminal plugin settings?
questions.help: Recommended: config.toml owns shell/env defaults and tool policy; plugin settings own panel placement and user terminal UI preferences.
options: config.toml owns shell/env defaults and tool policy; plugin settings own panel/UI preferences
All terminal settings belong in Terminal plugin settings
All terminal settings belong in config.toml
Shell/env in OS only; no C4OS config
Other

questions.label: What environment should the user terminal start with?
questions.help: Recommended: inherit the user's login shell environment with C4OS additions limited to explicit, documented variables.
options: User login shell environment plus explicit documented C4OS variables
Sanitized minimal environment
Project-defined environment only
Plugin setting decides
Other

questions.help: Clarify runtime command display, user terminal audit, shell selection, env mutation, config precedence, or whether terminal tool output can be mirrored into the user PTY.
